evidence.quote: My name is Kovacs. Like I said, the zip code is 28236.

observed_facts: The user provided only a last name ("Kovacs") instead of a full name when asked for first and last name.
The user refused to provide an email address, leading to a failed lookup when the agent searched with "Kovacs" as both first and last name.
inference: By providing incomplete name information (repeating the last name as the first name), the user caused the authentication lookup to fail, which ultimately led to the conversation being transferred to a human agent without completing the task.
needs_verification: Whether the user's first name was actually Mei (as seen in the reference run) and they withheld it.
parsed.summary: The user provided incomplete name information during authentication, causing the user lookup to fail and preventing task completion.
